$comment: Definitions that start with '_' (e.g. _Identity) are reusable components shared by both RalObjects and RalMethods. They do not represent valid standalone entities in the context of openRAL.
title: openRAL JSON Schema
description: This documents defines the schema for RalObjects and RalMethods of the openRAL.

RalMethod.description: A RalMethod represents a process that can be executed.

methodStateTemplates.description: Defines the method state templates. These determine the allowed values for methodState. For example, 'generalMethodState' allows values: undefined, planned, controlRequired, running, cancelled, finished. Multiple templates can be combined, mixing their allowed states.

executor.TODO: Wie ist das Schema des Executors definiert?
executor.description: Contains information about who executes the method

inputObjects.description: A list of objects that serve as input parameters for the RalMethod. These objects represent a specific state at the time of method creation, rather than a reference to the most current state.

role.description: Specifies the role of the input object in the RalMethod, similar to parameter names in programming language functions

inputObjectsRef.description: A list of references to RalObjects. These references always point to the most current state of the object, unlike inputObjects which represent a specific state for each object.

role.description: Specifies the role of the referenced object in the RalMethod

UID.description: The UUIDv4 of the referenced RalObject

domain.description: The domain where the RalObject can be found. If not provided, it's assumed to be in the current domain.

methodState.description: The current state of the method execution

enumDescriptions.planned: The method is planned but not yet executed
enumDescriptions.controlRequired: An error occurred that should be checked
enumDescriptions.running: The method is currently being executed

nestedMethods.description: A list of nested RalMethods that are executed as part of the parent RalMethod execution

outputObjects.description: A list of complete RalObjects that are the result of the method execution. These objects were either newly created or modified by the method.

role.description: Specifies the role of the output object in the RalMethod result

outputObjectsRef.description: A list of references to RalObjects that are the result of the method execution. These references point to objects that were either newly created or modified by the method.

role.description: Specifies the role of the referenced output object in the RalMethod result

UID.description: The UUIDv4 of the referenced RalObject

domain.description: The domain where the RalObject can be found. If not provided, it's assumed to be in the same domain as the current object.

objectConnectors.description: Defines how InputObjects or InputObjectsRef are passed to NestedMethods, similar to function calls in programming languages.

source.description: JSON Path referencing an InputObject or InputObjectsRef in the parent RalMethod

target.description: JSON Path referencing an InputObject or InputObjectsRef in a NestedMethod

targetRole.description: Defines the role the object will have in the NestedMethod

RalObject.description: A RalObject is the description of a real or digital object. It contains information about its state, owners, and methods and acts as a digital twin.

objectStateTemplates.description: Defines the object state templates. These determine the allowed values for objectState. For example, 'generalObjectState' allows values: undefined, active, inactive. Multiple templates can be combined, mixing their allowed states.

objectState.description: Current state of the object. Possible values depend on the objectStateTemplates defined in the template.

linkedObjectsRef.description: A list of references to RalObjects that are related to this object. The role 'owner' is reserved for ownership relationships.

role.description: Describes the role of the referenced RalObject and the relationship of the referenced object to the current object. The role 'owner' is reserved for ownership relationships.

UID.description: The UUIDv4 of the referenced RalObject

domain.description: The domain where the RalObject can be found. If not provided, it's assumed to be in the same domain as the current object.

currentGeolocation.description: Defines the current location of the object. Can be a physical location or a logical location by referencing a container object.

container.description: The container object that contains the object

UID.description: The UUIDv4 of the container object

domain.description: The domain where the Container RalObject can be found. If not provided, it's assumed to be in the same domain as the current object.

geoCoordinates.description: The geo coordinates of the object in latitude and longitude (WGS84)

3WordCode.description: A 3-word code for geographic positions is a system that divides the entire world into a grid of 3m x 3m squares, with each square assigned a unique combination of three words.

plusCode.description: Open Location Codes from Google. Similar to 3WordCode. Can have different lengths for different precision

postalAddress.description: The postal address of the object

cityNumber.description: The number of the city. Often a zip code

methodHistoryRef.description: References RalMethods that were executed on this object or will be executed in the future. The object could be an inputObject or an outputObject of the method.

methodState.description: The current state of the RalMethod

executor.description: The executor of the RalMethod. If only the RALType is given, any executor that inherits from this RALType can execute the

existenceStarts.description: Defines the time the real object that is represented by the RalObject started to exist

_Identity.description: Defines the identity of an entity

UID.description: A UUIDv4 that globally uniquely identifies the entire object

issuedBy.description: The identification system the alternative ID belongs to

alternateIDs.description: Optional alternative IDs that can be used in other environments

alternateNames.description: Optional alternative names that can be used in other environments

name.description: Optional name for easier human identification, not necessarily globally unique

siteTag.description: Also known as 'domain', indicates the environment where the object is stored

_Definition.description: Provides a general textual description of the RalType for the entity (RalMethod or RalObject). The description can be either directly in the definitionText or referenced via a URL in definitionURL. The description provides a general description the template/RalType and NOT the specific entity
examples: A farm is an agricultural entity engaged in crop cultivation and/or animal husbandry for the production of food and other products.

definitionText.description: General textual description of the RalType

definitionURL.description: URL referencing the general description of the RALTyp

_BaseTemplate.description: Defines the structure of a specific entity instance, similar but more restrictive than a JSON schema. All entites must have a template.

RALType.description: The unique name of the template for the entity. RALTypes should be selected from the official registry at https://open-ral.io to ensure cross-organizational interoperability. Use the semantic search API endpoint (/semantic_search) to discover appropriate official templates. Custom ralTypes are possible but must follow reverse-domain notation (e.g., com.organization.typeName) and come with interoperability trade-offs. See the 'Official vs. Custom RALTypes' section in the documentation for detailed guidance. The RALType is comparable to classes in object-oriented programming, where RalObjects are instances of these classes.

version.description: Optional field indicating the version of the RalType and its underlying template

_SpecificProperties.description: Special properties of the RalMethod, such as configuration values. Each key must be unique.

key.description: Unique identifier for the specific property

value.description: Value of the specific property. The type is defined by the unit.

unit.description: Unit of the value, should be a predefined unit from the unitExamples, but can be a custom one if needed.

unitExamples.number: number, can be integer or float
unitExamples.iso8601: date or duration in ISO 8601 format
unitExamples.JSONString: a string containing a json object
unitExamples.C: degree in celsius - unit of temperature
unitExamples.V: volt - unit of electric potential difference
unitExamples.dBm: decibel-milliwatt - unit of power e.g. for signal strength

description.description: Optional description explaining the meaning or purpose of the specific property
